questions.q: 4. In an election between two candidates, the total number of votes polled were ‘y’. Out of these, 40% votes were invalid . The winning candidate got 60% of the valid votes, while the other candidate lost by 6000 votes. Find the value of ‘y’.
questions.s:
4.(b)

Let the total votes (Y) = 100 units

40% votes are invalid then the valid vote is

= 60% of 100 = 60 unit

According to the question ,

Winning candidate got 60 % percent of valid votes

60% of 60 = 36 unit, and loser candidate got 24 units of vote

Difference of Vote between winner and loser candidate

36 - 24 = 12 unit

12 unit →6000 (given )

1 unit →  500

So,

100 unit → 50000

Y = 50000 votes

12 इकाई →6000 (दिया गया है )
